key.name: bar-smoke
key.description: How much the top bar is darkened behind its white text: 'none', 'light' (30%), 'medium' (45%, passes WCAG AA over a bright wallpaper) or 'heavy' (60%).

key.name: bar-text-shadow
key.description: A soft shadow under the text and icons of the top bar, to keep their edges crisp over a busy background.

key.name: liquid-switchers
key.description: The Alt+Tab and other switchers get liquid glass: the view behind them blurred and bent at the edges, with a lit rim.

key.name: switcher-icon-size
key.description: Largest size, in pixels, of the app icons in Alt+Tab. The shell uses 96 when they fit.

key.name: clear-menus
key.description: The top-bar menus (Quick Settings, the calendar, the small menus) use a lighter tint, as see-through as a 70 percent translucent terminal, so more of what is behind shows through. Text is harder to read over a bright window behind them.

key.name: popovers
key.description: Give menus, the calendar and notification banners the tinted glass material.
